title: Light Flickers at night- not good for sleep!
text: Light Flickers at night- not good for sleep!. This would have been the perfect humidifier if it weren’t for the fact that when you have it on at night, the rate of steam flow (levels 1-3) have a blue bar that lights up and moves up and down all night. It has a night mode where you can turn off the display all together, but then you can’t see anything. It’s so distracting my dog can’t stand it and puts her head under the blanket to avoid the flashing blue light. Why they made it Blink is a mystery. I KNOW it’s on level 3- it says “3” on the screen. Adding the chasing blue lights does nothing but keep us from sleeping. I don’t turn it off in night mode because if you want to change something with the remote, you can’t see. I would have returned it but was told I missed the window by 2 days. What a waste.
